title: Traits and the Environment
seo_title: Grade 3 Traits and Environment Worksheets: How Light, Water, Soil and Food Change Traits
standard_text: Use evidence to support the explanation that traits can be influenced by the environment.
meta_desc: Free Grade 3 science worksheets on how the environment affects traits (NGSS 3-LS3-2): plants grown with different light, water and soil, flamingos and food, and plant growth data. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_big: The environment can change some traits.
key_sub: Seeds from the same parent can grow differently if they get different light, water, soil or food.
body_html:
How to think about it

Living things inherit many traits from their parents. But the environment can also change some traits.

  • Plants that get too little light or water grow smaller, paler or weaker.
  • Plants in poor soil or crowded pots grow less.
  • Animals that eat too much or too little change size; flamingos turn pink from their food.
  • People who exercise get stronger.

If seeds from the same parent grow differently, the difference was caused by the environment.

Example

Bean seeds from one plant grow 25 cm in sun and 8 cm in shade. Why?

Same parents.

Different light.

Answer: The environment (light) affected their height.

Example

Is a flamingo's pink color inherited or from the environment?

It comes from its food.

Answer: from the environment

Common mistakes

  • Thinking all traits come only from parents.
  • Thinking seeds from the same plant always grow exactly the same.
  • Changing more than one thing in a plant test.

faq.q: How can the environment affect traits?
faq.a: Light, water, soil, food and exercise can change traits like height, color, size and strength.
The shrimp and algae they eat contain colors that turn their feathers pink.

faq.q: How can you show that the environment affects a trait?
faq.a: Grow seeds from the same parent plant in different conditions, change only one thing, and compare how they grow.

items.q: Grace notices that a pine tree high on a cold mountain grows short and twisted. What in the environment caused this?
c: only the traits from its parents
items.e: The environment affected this trait: the cold and wind.

items.q: Identical twins grow up in different places. One eats more healthy food and exercises more. What might be different?
items.e: Weight and strength can be affected by the environment.

items.q: Luis notices that a hydrangea bush in some soils has blue flowers instead of pink. What in the environment caused this?
c: only the traits from its parents
items.e: The environment affected this trait: the kind of soil.

items.q: Why are flamingos pink?
c: Pink is the color of all birds.
The shrimp and algae they eat make their feathers pink.
items.e: Their food affects their color.

items.q: Nora is making a chart of traits. What mostly decides “a cat's eye color”?
c: both inherited and affected by the environment
items.e: A cat's eye color is mostly inherited from parents.

items.e: Plants need light to grow well.

items.e: The environment affected this trait: the strong wind.
